root_cause.text: The function `target_tg_pt_gp_members_show()` uses the return value of `snprintf()` (which can be larger than the actual stack buffer due to long fabric WWNs) as the length for `memcpy()` without validating it against the source buffer size, causing an out-of-bounds read from the stack buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "snprintf() returns the length the output would have had, which can exceed the buffer size when the fabric WWN is long ... memcpy() will read past the stack buffer". The patch adds a check `if (cur_len > TG_PT_GROUP_NAME_BUF || ...)` to prevent this.

intent_record.what: Extended condition from `(cur_len + len) > PAGE_SIZE` to `cur_len > TG_PT_GROUP_NAME_BUF || (cur_len + len) > PAGE_SIZE`.
intent_record.how: Adds a check that if the current accumulated length `cur_len` exceeds the constant `TG_PT_GROUP_NAME_BUF`, the function will issue a warning and break out of the loop, preventing further writes to the buffer.
